/-- A byte string as numbers. -/
def nats (v : List U8) : List Nat := v.map (·.val)

spec.name: Allowlisted
spec.code:
/-- Paths the guest-access guard leaves open. -/
def Allowlisted (path : List Nat) : Prop :=
  path ∈ [lit "/health", lit "/healthz", lit "/ready", lit "/readyz", lit "/livez",
          lit "/api/v1/system/config", lit "/v2/token", lit "/api/v1/auth", lit "/api/v1/setup"] ∨
  lit "/api/v1/auth/" <+: path ∨ lit "/api/v1/setup/" <+: path

spec.name: NoCredential
spec.code:
/-- The request presents no credential: no header that can carry one, and no
conda token channel in the path. -/
def NoCredential (req : http.Request) : Prop :=
  (∀ h ∈ req.headers.val, nats h.1.val ∉
    [lit "authorization", lit "x-api-key", lit "cookie", lit "x-nuget-apikey"]) ∧
  ¬ (lit "conda/" <+: (nats req.path.val).dropWhile (· = 47))

lean.name: middleware.guest_access_guard
lean.code:
/-- [artifactkeeper_kernel::middleware::guest_access_guard]:
    Source: 'src/middleware.rs', lines 217:0-240:1
    Visibility: public -/
def middleware.guest_access_guard
  (guest_access_enabled : Bool) (oracle : trusted.Oracle) (req : http.Request)
  :
  Result middleware.Outcome
  := do
  if guest_access_enabled
  then ok (middleware.Outcome.Next none false)
  else
    let s := alloc.vec.Vec.deref req.path
    let b ← paths.is_allowlisted s
    if b
    then ok (middleware.Outcome.Next none false)
    else
      let s1 := alloc.vec.Vec.deref req.path
      let oci ← paths.is_oci_v2_path s1
      let extracted ← http.extract_visibility_token req
      let outcome ← resolve.try_resolve_auth_outcome oracle extracted true
      let s2 := alloc.vec.Vec.deref req.headers
      let for_browser ← http.is_browser_request s2
      match outcome with
      | resolve.AuthOutcome.Resolved _ =>
        ok (middleware.Outcome.Next none false)
      | resolve.AuthOutcome.NoCredential =>
        if oci
        then
          ok (middleware.Outcome.Respond middleware.Response.OciUnauthorized)
        else
          ok (middleware.Outcome.Respond (middleware.Response.GuestUnauthorized
            for_browser))
      | resolve.AuthOutcome.InvalidCredential =>
        if oci
        then
          ok (middleware.Outcome.Respond middleware.Response.OciUnauthorized)
        else
          ok (middleware.Outcome.Respond (middleware.Response.GuestUnauthorized
            for_browser))
      | resolve.AuthOutcome.Overloaded =>
        ok (middleware.Outcome.Respond middleware.Response.ServiceUnavailable)

    Visibility: public -/
def http.is_browser_request
  (headers : Slice ((alloc.vec.Vec Std.U8) × (alloc.vec.Vec Std.U8))) :
  Result Bool
  := do
  let s ←
    lift (Array.to_slice
      (Array.make 14#usize [
        115#u8, 101#u8, 99#u8, 45#u8, 102#u8, 101#u8, 116#u8, 99#u8, 104#u8,
        45#u8, 109#u8, 111#u8, 100#u8, 101#u8
        ]))
  let b ← http.contains_key headers s
  if b
  then ok true
  else
    let s1 ←
      lift (Array.to_slice
        (Array.make 14#usize [
          115#u8, 101#u8, 99#u8, 45#u8, 102#u8, 101#u8, 116#u8, 99#u8, 104#u8,
          45#u8, 115#u8, 105#u8, 116#u8, 101#u8
          ]))
    let b1 ← http.contains_key headers s1
    if b1
    then ok true
    else
      let s2 ←
        lift (Array.to_slice
          (Array.make 6#usize [ 97#u8, 99#u8, 99#u8, 101#u8, 112#u8, 116#u8 ]))
      let o ← http.header_str headers s2
      match o with
      | none => ok false
      | some v =>
        let s3 := alloc.vec.Vec.deref v
        let v1 ← strs.ascii_lowercase s3
        let s4 := alloc.vec.Vec.deref v1
        let s5 ←
          lift (Array.to_slice
            (Array.make 9#usize [
              116#u8, 101#u8, 120#u8, 116#u8, 47#u8, 104#u8, 116#u8, 109#u8,
              108#u8
              ]))
        strs.contains s4 s5

lean.code:
/-- [artifactkeeper_kernel::http::extract_visibility_token]:
    Source: 'src/http.rs', lines 202:0-214:1
    Visibility: public -/
def http.extract_visibility_token
  (req : http.Request) : Result http.ExtractedToken := do
  let extracted ← http.extract_token req
  let b ←
    match extracted with
    | http.ExtractedToken.Bearer _ => ok false
    | http.ExtractedToken.ApiKey _ => ok false
    | http.ExtractedToken.Basic _ => ok false
    | http.ExtractedToken.None => ok true
    | http.ExtractedToken.Invalid => ok false
  if b
  then
    let s := alloc.vec.Vec.deref req.path
    let o ← paths.extract_conda_url_token s
    match o with
    | none =>
      let o1 ← http.extract_nuget_push_api_key req
      match o1 with
      | none => ok http.ExtractedToken.None
      | some token => ok (http.ExtractedToken.ApiKey token)
    | some token => ok (http.ExtractedToken.ApiKey token)
  else ok extracted
